# arm64 (aarch64) Ubuntu 24.04 Emacs 30.1 + tree-sitter port — recipe & gotchas

Porting the amd64 `emacs-30.1-treesitter-ubuntu-24.04` builder to genuine
**aarch64** on an x86_64 WSL host, producing two relocatable tarballs
(`arm64.emacs30.1_24.04.tar.gz` + `arm64.dev.base.24.04.tar.gz`) that
install via `tar -zxf … -C /` and run on Apple-Silicon Docker (linux/arm64)
and arm Linux.

## Build platform

- Host is **x86_64 WSL**, target is **arm64** → build under emulation:
  `docker buildx build --platform linux/arm64 …` (QEMU binfmt).
- Emulated emacs build ≈ **70 min**; each pack ≈ 3–5 min; a native-compile
  probe ≈ 20 min. Budget accordingly.
- **No corp proxy** — the SOCKS proxy is closed; direct internet works.
  Do NOT pass a proxy arg to `build.macos.sh`.
- Dedicated arch folders (HARD RULE 3a): `…-arm64/` — never bolt arm64
  scripts onto the amd64 folder.

## QEMU quirks

- `bash -lc` **hangs** under QEMU while sourcing `.bashrc`. For any probe
  use `docker run --entrypoint bash <img> -c '…'` (no login shell).
- `file` is **not** in stock `ubuntu:24.04`. Check ELF arch via the
  `e_machine` field: `od -An -tx1 -j18 -N2 <bin>` → **`b700` == AArch64**
  (0x00B7 little-endian). `3e00` == x86-64.

## THE manifest (`arm64.tar.list`)

Hand-curated, checked into the repo, fed to `tar -T`. When porting, the
inherited list drifts badly — regenerate it robustly from the built image:

1. KEEP every inherited entry that still exists in the image.
2. Compute the runtime `.so` closure with `ldd` on `emacs`, `vterm-module.so`,
   and `libtree-sitter*`, following symlink chains.
3. Take `/root/local` (emacs install) + `/root/etc/el` (minus `.git`) wholesale.
4. Add toolchain via `dpkg -L` of the owning packages (see below).
5. Validate: **0 entries missing in image**, **0 x86_64 files in tarball**
   (`tar tzf … | grep -i x86_64` must be empty).

Drift seen during this port: SONAME bumps (libtree-sitter `0.26`→`0.24`),
native-lisp hash change (`59aa9584`→`fc460086`), pdmp fingerprint change,
grammars-not-in-fresh-image.

## GOTCHA 1 — native-comp needs the **gcc-14** libgccjit toolchain

Even though the Dockerfile builds Emacs with `CC=gcc-10`, the **runtime**
`libgccjit.so.0` that Emacs loads is the **gcc-14** one
(`/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libgccjit.so.0.0.1`, ~35 MB, from `libgccjit0`
which tracks ubuntu:24.04's default gcc-14). It hardcodes
`GCC_EXEC_PREFIX=/usr/lib/gcc/aarch64-linux-gnu/14` and its driver needs
`…/14/crtbeginS.o`, `-lgcc`, `-lgcc_s`.

→ The tarball MUST ship the **gcc-14 crt/support** (`libgcc-14-dev` +
`gcc-14`/`cpp-14` closure), NOT gcc-10. Diagnosed by wrapping `/usr/bin/ld`
to log argv+env (revealed `GCC_EXEC_PREFIX=…/14`).
Verify: `NC-OK sq(9)=81` from a real `native-compile` → load → call.

## GOTCHA 2 — tree-sitter is two independent layers

**Layer 1 — core lib** `libtree-sitter.so.0.24` (ABI **14**, matches
`treesit-library-abi-version`). Load-bearing pin: **v0.24.x, NOT 0.25**
(`TREE_SITTER_TAG=v0.24.7`) — Emacs 30.1 `treesit.c` speaks ABI ≤14.
Shipped in the tarball; links fine.

**Layer 2 — per-language grammar `.so`** (python.so, c.so, …). **NOT shipped.**
Installed **at runtime, on-target, from the web**: when Emacs starts and a
`*-ts-mode` activates (or you run `M-x do-treesit-compile`, see
`tree-sitter/treesit-compile.el`), `treesit-install-language-grammar`:
1. **`git clone`s** the grammar repo (pinned tag, e.g. python `v0.23.6`),
2. **compiles it with `cc`** on the target into `~/.emacs.d/tree-sitter/`.

Grammar versions are pinned in `treesit-compile.el` specifically so the
compiled grammar emits **ABI ≤14** (HEAD now emits ABI 15 → needs
tree-sitter ≥0.24 core; would break). Do NOT bump grammar pins casually.

This runtime install therefore needs, **on the target**:
- **`git`** — comes from the **devbox** tarball (`dev.base` bundles git),
  NOT from the emacs tarball. The two tarballs are installed **together**.
- **network to GitHub**.
- a **working C compiler** — see GOTCHA 3.

## GOTCHA 3 — grammar compile needs the **gcc-13 `cc1` backend** (`/libexec/`)

The killer, and the reason grammar-install failed long after native-comp
worked. `treesit-install-language-grammar` shells out to **`cc`**
(→ `gcc` → **gcc-13** via alternatives), which needs the C compiler
**backend `cc1`**. On ubuntu:24.04 gcc-13's cc1 lives in the **libexec**
path, not the old lib path:

    /usr/libexec/gcc/aarch64-linux-gnu/13/cc1        ← owned by cpp-13-aarch64-linux-gnu
    /usr/libexec/gcc/aarch64-linux-gnu/13/collect2
    /usr/libexec/gcc/aarch64-linux-gnu/13/lto-wrapper
    /usr/libexec/gcc/aarch64-linux-gnu/13/lto1

The inherited manifest only shipped the **gcc-10** cc1
(`/usr/lib/gcc/…/10/cc1`) — wrong version AND wrong path → the gcc-13
driver couldn't find its backend:

    cc: fatal error: cannot execute 'cc1': execvp: No such file or directory

native-comp did **not** expose this because libgccjit calls its own
in-process JIT, needing only crt/libgcc — never `cc1`.

→ Ship the full **`cpp-13-aarch64-linux-gnu`** + **`gcc-13`** + `libgcc-13-dev`
closure, including `/usr/libexec/gcc/aarch64-linux-gnu/13/{cc1,collect2,lto1,lto-wrapper}`
and `/usr/lib/gcc/aarch64-linux-gnu/13/{crt*.o,libgcc*}`.
(24 such entries were missing from the inherited list; adding them fixed it.)

## Verification (all must pass in a fresh `--platform linux/arm64 ubuntu:24.04`)

    [2] emacs e_machine  = b700
    [3] GNU Emacs 30.1
    [4] TREESIT=t ABI=14
    [5] VTERM-LOADED
    [6] NC-OK sq(9)=81                       ← native-comp (gcc-14 crt)
    (install git — simulates devbox tarball also installed)
    [7] GRAMMAR-INSTALLED                    ← git clone from web + cc compile
    [8] grammar e_machine = b700  GRAMMAR-AARCH64-OK
    [9] PARSE-OK root=module

## Two-tarball design (why the emacs tarball ships no git)

- `arm64.emacs30.1_24.04.tar.gz` = Emacs + native-comp toolchain (gcc-14
  crt) + grammar-compile backend (gcc-13 cc1) + tree-sitter **core**.
  Ships **no git** and **no grammars**.
- `arm64.dev.base.24.04.tar.gz` = git + ssh + base dev tools.
- Install **both** on target → `M-x do-treesit-compile` has git (devbox)
  + cc/cc1 (emacs) + network → downloads & compiles grammars on first use.

## GOTCHA 4 — devbox Dockerfile couples dev.base to ALL language packs

The full `devbox-ubuntu-24.04-arm64/Dockerfile` is multi-stage:
`cpp_install → rust_install → js_install → py_install → csharp_install → dev`.
The final `dev` stage (which produces `arm64.dev.base.24.04.tar.gz`)
`COPY --from`s **all five** language-pack stages, so building `dev.base`
drags in the entire cargo/npm/uv/dotnet chain — very slow and fragile under
QEMU. It died at `cpp_install`'s `apt list | dpkg -L | xargs file | … | tar`
pipeline (exit 2) — a `file` edge case emitting a bad path under emulation.

But the `dev.base` **pack** itself only needs **ssh + git** (see the final
`RUN … tar czf $DEV_PKG` — it greps for `ssh|libwrap0` and `git`, never the
language packs). So for the base deliverable, use the trimmed
**`Dockerfile.base`** (ssh+git+config only, no `COPY --from`, and drop the
corp `git config http.proxy socks5://host.docker.internal:8080` which would
break git on a direct-internet target). Build + pack:

    docker buildx build --platform linux/arm64 -f Dockerfile.base . \
      -t caapi/arm64.devbox.base:24.04
    ./pack.base.arm64.sh          # → arm64.dev.base.24.04.tar.gz (~11M)

Verify: 0 x86_64 paths; `usr/bin/git` is `e_machine=b700`; contains
`usr/sbin/sshd`, `root/.gitconfig`, `bin/entry`.
Build the language packs later from the full Dockerfile if needed.

## GOTCHA 5 — dev.base must ship git's HTTPS closure + ca-certificates

The devbox pack originally grepped only `ssh|libwrap0` + `git` **package**
files — it did NOT include git's **runtime `ldd` closure**. So on-target
`git clone https://…` (the grammar install) failed with:

    git-remote-https: error while loading shared libraries:
      libcurl-gnutls.so.4: cannot open shared object file

`git-remote-https` (the HTTPS transport helper) pulls a big closure:
`libcurl-gnutls.so.4`, `libgnutls.so.30`, `libnghttp2.so.14`,
`libssh.so.4`, `librtmp.so.1`, `libpsl.so.5`, krb5 (`libgssapi_krb5`,
`libkrb5`, `libk5crypto`, …), `libldap`, `libsasl2`, brotli, zstd, etc.
Plus, even once curl loads, HTTPS to GitHub needs the **CA bundle**
(`/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt` + `/usr/share/ca-certificates` +
the symlinks under `/etc/ssl/certs`).

Fix: `pack.base.arm64.sh` computes the file list on the **host** from the
built image — ssh + git package files + **`ldd /usr/lib/git-core/git-remote-https`
closure (symlink chains followed)** + ca-certificates — and **validates
every entry exists** before tarring (0-missing), avoiding the fragile
in-image `file | tar` pipeline (that pipeline exits 2 under QEMU on a
single bad path; see GOTCHA 4). Result: dev.base ~18M, 709 entries,
0 x86_64. Combined smoke then goes green end-to-end:
grammar install uses git-from-devbox → clone from web → cc/cc1-from-emacs
compile → aarch64 grammar.so → PARSE-OK.

## Load-bearing pins (do NOT bump without asking)

- `TREE_SITTER_TAG=v0.24.7`  (core lib ABI 14; NOT 0.25)
- `EMACS_LIBVTERM_COMMIT=54c29d14bca05bdd8ae60cda01715d727831e3f9`
- grammar tags in `tree-sitter/treesit-compile.el` (python v0.23.6, c v0.23.6,
  tsx v0.23.2, …) — chosen for ABI ≤14.
